effective_from: creative10-20260922 attempts 04 onward, before any author initialization
rationale: Add an independent pre-draft novelty review, retaining the same critic for post-draft source/contribution review. Early attempts showed self-assessment alone was too permissive.
novelty_gate: Search closest arguments, not merely distinctive wording. Read primary works as accessible. PASS_RELATIVE requires explicit contribution beyond closest works and qualified coverage; duplicate ideas must be revised or rejected before manuscript drafting.
independent_critique: Two separate fresh sessions per essay; no access to other essays or each other's review before delivering their own review.
revision: Author may disagree with criticism with reasons. A substantially changed thesis requires a renewed search before the revised manuscript.
comparability: Exploratory method change after attempts 01-03. Those originals remain v1; subsequent attempts have additional independent pre-draft checking. Not a controlled comparison.
budget: Ten private essays and two reviews per essay, no paid API, publication, submission or quota scheduler. No minimum manuscript length; 6000-word ceiling excluding bibliography.
pre_draft_review: After author sources/selection, second-critic role independently checks exact proposal before draft. Precheck reports and source snapshots are archived, with explicit lineage selection and a release receipt. Failed proposals are revised with new evidence or set aside; no manuscript before PASS_RELATIVE independent release.
